    Namespace GameFramework.StateMachine.GameStates

    Classes

    BootstrapState

    Bootstrap state handles initial game setup using constructor injection for all dependencies. All required services are injected via constructor rather than resolved at runtime.

    CreditsState

    Credits state - manages the credits screen and handles navigation Responsible for its UI lifecycle and event handling

    GameOverState

    Game Over state - manages the game over screen and handles player choices Responsible for its UI lifecycle and event handling

    LoadingState

    Loading state that handles different loading scenarios using unified GameSession system Creates or loads GameSession based on loading configuration Integrates with TimeService for proper playtime handling

    MainMenuState

    Main menu state - fully responsible for its UI lifecycle Handles all UI transitions based on user interactions reported by the screen

    NewGameState

    New Game state - fully responsible for its UI lifecycle Handles all UI transitions based on user interactions reported by the screen

    PlayingState

    Playing state - reacts to pause state changes from PauseService Manages UI in response to actual pause/resume events

    QuitState

    Quit state - handles graceful application shutdown with progress feedback Responsible for cleaning up resources, and exiting the application

    SplashState

    Splash state with event-driven input handling and constructor injection

    VictoryState

    Victory state - manages the victory screen and celebrates player success Responsible for its UI lifecycle and event handling
